description: List the Article III federal judges appointed by a US president, from the Federal Judicial Center directory, with counts by court level (Supreme Court, courts of appeals, district courts). Returns each appointee's name, court, commission date and current service status. Answers "how many judges did Biden appoint", "which Supreme Court justices did Reagan appoint", "Trump appellate appointees".

court_type.description: Optional: restrict to one court level.

limit.description: Max appointments listed (default 50, max 200). Totals cover all of them.

president.description: President name or surname, e.g. "Joseph R. Biden", "Biden", "Obama", "George W. Bush".

name: fjc_judges_by_president
title: Fjc Judges By President
